source_note: 采用新浪文章两张实景而非洛阳同名香山寺。近照清楚显示两层佛龛及上部塔身，塔基被邻殿遮挡，图版不复原。来源不是开放图库，作者只可核文章发布账号，单张摄影者未明确。 第二次内置 image_gen 清除门洞灰填充并稀疏檐线，首稿已存 assets/generated/drafts/hn_xiangshan-v1.png，全部实际提示词和输入在 generation_history。
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Image 2 (and subsequent photos if applicable) is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: draw the actual named monument in that reference, preserving its identifying silhouette, roof type, visible storey count, bay count, openings, and proportions.
Create a refined, sparse BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE line drawing. Use confident fine contours with a few finer internal structural lines. All surfaces remain WHITE; use outlines for doors and windows rather than dark fills. No solid shadows, no broad grey shading, no crosshatching, no pencil grain, no texture, no gradient. No color, no gold, no black background. The white will become transparent and the ink the relevant dynasty color in the website.
Show the complete monument, centered, approximately straight-on at facade level, with verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Use only a few short ground lines. Remove tourists, foliage, vehicles, wires, modern signage, fences obstructing the structure, neighboring distractions and sky. Preserve architectural ornament selectively, without filling every roof tile or brick. No invented features. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border.
Wide compositions: landscape 1536×1024, entire building occupies about 82% of canvas width, roof/apex and base uncut, balanced breathing room. Tall pagodas: portrait 1024×1536, entire pagoda occupies about 82% of height, centred with equal side margins, apex and base uncut.


SUBJECT-SPECIFIC INSTRUCTIONS:
Revise the line drawing in image 3 of the visible upper tower of Xiangshan Temple Dabei Guanyin Dashi Pagoda in Pingdingshan. Photo 2 is the exact real pagoda reference and image 1 is the delicate sparse style master. KEEP the existing drawing silhouette, taper, eight VISIBLE eave tiers above the obscured base, two lower visible niche bands, partial arched opening on the lower right, and bottom contour fading into white. The complete real pagoda is nine-storey, but the bottom is obscured in the photo, so do not add a new base or eave. ONLY IMPROVE THE LINE STYLE: remove every gray/black fill inside ALL window and niche openings; these must have pure white interiors and thin empty outline shapes. REDUCE each eave ledge to at most THREE fine contour lines; delete the many tightly packed parallel courses that currently create dark bands. Keep the wall planes totally blank white and retain sparse arch-shaped niche outlines, no masonry texture, no hatching or shading. Also correct the finial to the narrow spindle of small stacked discs on a bulbous base as in the photo, avoiding oversized round beads. Make all outer contour lines approximately one third thinner, even more delicate for internal lines. Do not introduce any new objects, letters, color, background or shadows. Preserve the actual incomplete visible-lower-tower presentation with a soft line-ending into white, entire study centered and uncropped with generous margins, portrait 1024x1536.

site_recommendation.name: 香山寺观音大士塔
site_recommendation.era: 北宋 · 熙宁元年重建
site_recommendation.yearNote: 取市文旅局记载的宋熙宁元年重建年；寺塔原始创建年代不详，后世继续修葺。
site_recommendation.place: 河南 · 平顶山市香山
site_recommendation.coordinate_note: Amap 公开古迹点位（GCJ-02），非测绘坐标。香山位于新华区与宝丰交界，寺有南北入口；市文旅局按宝丰闹店镇大张庄村南记载，地图 POI 列新华区，地点统一显示平顶山市香山。
site_recommendation.lede: 两层密集小龛托起逐层收分的八角塔身。香山寺的宋塔与蔡京书碑，把中原观音信仰留在了砖石之间。

facts.label: 现存宋塔
facts.text: 据平顶山市文旅局，塔于 1068 年敕赐重建，八角九级、高 33 米，后世屡有修缮。

facts.label: 塔身形制
facts.text: 砖砌叠涩出檐，檐上有平座；下部塔壁列小佛龛，上层辟门洞，逐级收分。

facts.label: 所绘范围
facts.text: 图版依据两张实拍取现状可见塔身，底层被邻殿遮挡的部分以留白收束；不复原隐藏的塔基。

SUBJECT-SPECIFIC INSTRUCTIONS:
Draw ONLY the clearly visible UPPER TOWER of the actual Dabei Guanyin Dashi Pagoda at Xiangshan Temple in Pingdingshan/Baofeng, Henan 香山寺大悲观音大士塔, based primarily on image 2. Image 3 shows the same tower from the front as supplementary silhouette evidence. The real monument is an octagonal nine-storey brick pagoda, but its lowest parts are obscured by buildings in these photos: do NOT invent a tall exposed ground storey, an entrance portal, a platform or an additional visible eave level. Reproduce the visible tapering sequence of octagonal tower storeys and brick corbel eaves EXACTLY as in photo 2 from finial down to the lowest exposed niche-covered tower wall. The lower visible two wall bands have small Buddha niches; express only 5 or 6 sparse tiny arch-outline niches on each visible face, enough to identify the bands without dense repetition. Upper walls have small plain openings, one per visible face where seen, represented with white outline interiors. Preserve the heavy angular brick corbel eaves as 2 or 3 lines each, not timber roofs or elaborate brackets. The tiny finial has a bulb and stacked discs, and must remain fully visible. Correct vertical perspective only slightly; preserve three visible tower facets. At the bottom, use a few light discontinuous contours that stop where the tower becomes hidden in the photo and fade into generous white space. Omit foreground temple roofs, steles and trees entirely: this is explicitly a visible-upper-tower study, NOT a reconstructed complete pagoda. No brick texture, no crosshatching, no grey shading. Keep tower about 75 percent of image height, large blank white margins on all sides, portrait 1024x1536.
generation_history.review: 可见八道出檐及两层佛龛符合照片，但门洞带灰填充、檐部线条密，进行第二次样式修订。
